name: 19984-b64image-qwen25vl7b-1gpu
hardware: 1x H100 80GB HBM3, one GPU of an a3 node (--gres=gpu:1).
parallelism: TP=1, PP=1, DP=1, one vLLM engine, one frontend.
architecture: Qwen2_5_VLForConditionalGeneration, bf16, 7B: 28-layer decoder (hidden 3584, 28 query heads, 4 KV heads) plus a ViT vision tower.
load_profile: concurrent (CLOSED loop), streams=16, bounded at 1200 requests with an 1800 s safety cap, warmup the first 25% by completion.
workload: Single-image visual-question chat. One synthetic image per request (guidellm `synthetic_image`, 2048x2048, `format: jpeg`, `jpeg_quality: 100`, `content: noise`, `seed: 42`, a fresh RNG stream per row) delivered the way the OpenAI chat schema delivers one, plus a 32-token instruction, answered in exactly 16 tokens (`max_tokens: 16`, `ignore_eos: true`, `temperature: 0.0`). `mm-processor-kwargs {"max_pixels": 200704}` caps every image at 256 vision tokens.
purpose: A single-image visual question answering assistant on one GPU, serving 16 concurrent users short captioned answers.
launch:
model: Qwen/Qwen2.5-VL-7B-Instruct
tensor-parallel-size: 1
dtype: bfloat16
max-model-len: 4096
max-num-seqs: 32
# Must match scenario.json's `images_per_request: 1`: it is both the admission limit and what the
# engine's startup profiling pass is sized against. Change one and you must change both.
limit-mm-per-prompt: {"image": 1}
mm-processor-kwargs: {"max_pixels": 200704}
gpu-memory-utilization: 0.90
enable-prefix-caching: false
disable-mm-preprocessor-cache: true
